start: Finish screen or a workout's page

steps.action: Tap 'Share as text' ('Paste it into any AI chat for advice')
user_sees: The phone's share list with the workout as plain text
must_not: Two share lists after a second tap

user_sees: The text arrives with lifts, sets, reps and weights
must_not: Body weight or the member's phone number in the text

start: Progress, a month (or a year) menu

steps.action: Tap 'Share as text' in the menu
user_sees: Menu slides away, then the share list with that month's text
must_not: The share list opening under the menu
Another month's workouts in the text

start: Text cannot be built or shared

user_sees: Message "Couldn't share it as text" - 'Please try again.'
must_not: The row stays busy for ever

steps.action: Cancel the share list, tap 'Share as text' again
must_not: The row dead after a cancel

start: Text shared to an AI chat

user_sees: Only workout facts leave, by the member's own choice
must_not: Name, phone number, body weight or photos in the text
Anything sent to MettleUp or the gym
